name: The Tech Interactive Teen Volunteer Program (Holiday Helper)
what_you_do: Teen volunteers lead hands-on science, tech and art activities for museum visitors. This is during the holiday season. Volunteers complete six shifts. Each shift is 3 to 4 hours.
who_can_apply: Teens who are 14 or older by Nov 21, 2026.
duration: Six shifts in the peak windows: Nov 21 to 29 and Dec 19 to Jan 3
deadline_text: Holiday Helper applications are closed as of Nov 2, 2026. The 2026 window was listed as Oct 9 to Oct 23. Check back after the New Year for summer teen programs.
how_to_apply: Applications are closed. Check the official page after the New Year for summer teen programs. Teen portal: vhub.at/TeenVolunteer. Questions: volunteer@thetech.org or 408-294-8324.
notes: You must go to one orientation. Pick Saturday Nov 14, Nov 21 or Dec 5, 2026, 9:00 AM to 12:30 PM. They read applications after the deadline. Dates shown are from the 2026 cycle.
